title: zanthoxylum atchoum
intro: Zanthoxylum atchoum, commonly known as Ethiopian pepper tree, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Ethiopian folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Zanthoxylum atchoum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic and anti-diarrheal effects. The plant is also used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and bronchodilatory properties.
